## Start with three pages

1. [What is LAE?](primer.qmd) — understand one low-altitude service and the words used for it.
2. [Course overview](overview.qmd) — see what the course covers and how the weeks connect.
3. [Week 1](week-01.qmd) — begin the lecture notes.

**That is enough to begin.** You can open the other Orient pages whenever a question comes up.

## Look up more when needed

- **Who creates value and who gets paid?** [How does LAE work?](business-overview.qmd)
- **Who makes the rules in Hong Kong?** [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd)
- **Need a quick answer?** [Common questions](faq.qmd)
- **Need a sourced figure?** [Key numbers](key-figures.qmd)
- **Prefer a brief introduction on video?** [LAE 101 videos](videos.qmd)

For a term or a dated programme claim, use the [Glossary](glossary.qmd) or [Official status](tracker.qmd).

## Then Teach

Classroom worked examples use round figures for learning — cite [Key numbers](key-figures.qmd) and [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd#standing-caveats) for programme facts.

- **Teach** menu — one page per week (notes, summary, readings, plus a class-outline PDF). Start with [Week 1](week-01.qmd).  
- Each week page is the main notes. The PDF is a shorter class outline — not a substitute for the note.
- **Self-check** — short multiple-choice questions at the end of each week page (Weeks 1–12; private practice; nothing is stored). Example: [Week 1 · Self-check](week-01.qmd#self-check). All weeks also collected under Review: [Self-check](quizzes.qmd).

## Review

Formulas, tables, figures, readings, and Self-check quizzes collected from the week notes.

- [Formulas](formulas.qmd) — named teaching identities from the week notes.
- [Tables](tables.qmd) — named teaching tables from the week notes.
- [Figures](figures.qmd) — teaching diagrams from the week notes.
- [Readings](readings.qmd) — documents listed on the week notes.
- [Self-check](quizzes.qmd) — practice questions from Weeks 1–12 (same MCQs as on each week page).

## Official facts

- [Glossary](glossary.qmd) — terms and diagrams  
- [Official status](tracker.qmd) — [OPEN]{.status-chip .status-open} / [WATCH]{.status-chip .status-watch} / [settled]{.status-chip .status-settled} labels  
- [Companies & sectors](landscape.qmd) — who is in the market  

## Updates

- [Government news](news.qmd) — dated government and regulatory items  
- [Business news](industry.qmd) — dated company and industry items  
- [Use cases](usecases.qmd) — trial and operating applications  
- [Timeline](dates.qmd) — dated instruments and milestones  

This site has no Blackboard admin. Course logistics stay on the teaching platform.
